_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Sanya kowane wasika zuwa lamba ta daban don riƙe lissafin.
Sanya da `[A 5]`, sake sanya a kowane lokaci.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sauran tsarin aiki. Yi amfani da `[A 5]`.
invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Harafin {letter} ba a cikin wuyar warwarewa ba.
invalid_move.digit_used: Lambar {digit} da aka riga aka yi amfani da ita ta {used_letter}.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Lambar farko ta kalma ba za ta iya zama 0 ba.

outcome.incorrect: Taswirar ta cika amma lissafin ba daidai ba ne.
